items.title: Target delays key emissions goals
items.summary: Target has become the latest major company to downgrade its emission goals.

items.title: Ocado expands ‘future of food’ aisle to promote sustainable brands
items.summary: Ocado has expanded its curated grocery aisle offering to support and spotlight brands that promote healthier and more sustainable food.

items.title: TPE invests £1bn in battery trains amid push to decarbonise UK transport
items.summary: TransPennine Express (TPE) has confirmed that the £1bn investment will help to deliver Britain's first mainline battery-electric trains.

items.title: ‘Buy less, buy better, buy different’: How NHS Supply Chain is tackling Scope 3
items.summary: With the Sustainable Supply Chains Summit around the corner, edie sat down with the head of sustainability at NHS Supply Chain, Heidi Barnard, to find out how the organisation approaches sustainability for its 650,000-product catalogue.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: Practical actions to drive circularity across the business value chain
items.summary: In two weeks’ time, edie will hold its new webinar exploring how organisations can turn circular economy commitments into practical, measurable action across the business value chain.

items.title: El Niño: Indonesia fire emissions in 2026 ‘on track’ to match record for this century
items.summary: Wildfires currently burning large swathes of land in Indonesia are on track to produce emissions on a par with the country’s most-intense fire season this century, according to experts.

items.title: Factcheck: Reform UK’s 45 false or misleading claims about climate and energy
items.summary: Reform UK, led by Nigel Farage, has emerged as a major force in UK politics in recent years – pushing anti-net-zero policies, alongside vehement opposition to immigration.

items.title: Revealed: More than 1,000 NHS operations cancelled due to record UK heatwaves
items.summary: More than 1,000 operations at NHS hospitals were cancelled due to heat during the UK’s record May and June heatwaves , Carbon Brief can reveal.

items.title: 沒有毒又愛吃的紅斑蛇
不只看天災 更要比「韌性」全球城市氣候韌性評比台北倒數第十
